## Notes

- Axis Malta Availability Table, 44.42. Read twice, from the archive.org scan (jp2 177, the Axis chart set) and the community chart PDFs (Axis Charts.pdf p. 35): 0 of 44 cells differ.
- Two dice, added, in the chosen level's column. in_play: the percentage of each type of aircraft in play based in Italy and Sicily that may join the raid. strategic: aircraft of each type not in play (the Axis strategic air force), as a percentage of that type's count in Italy and Sicily, fractions down; they fly only that turn's Malta missions. null (printed na): no strategic forces this Game-Turn.
